senses.gloss: f. (קָרַץ) compressing the lips, gesture of anger, scorn &c.—Pl. קְרִיצוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 108b:6">Yeb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>מכרת ברמיזותיו וקְרִיצוֹתָיו</he> she is familiar with his hints and gestures (by which she may be influenced).
<cite ref="Yevamot 108b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>קְרִיצוֹתֵיהֶם ורמיזותיהם</he> their gestures and hints.
